Keep Repository files up to date with automatic polling.

## Added

- Automatically refresh the Repository file tree, Git status, and selected file
  contents using the same reload settings as Changes, every three seconds by
  default.
- Respect `--watch`, `--no-watch`, and the configured reload interval in both
  views. Manual reload remains available.

## Fixed

- Preserve browsing position and tree state during automatic updates, including
  the Changed file filter and updates to unrelated files.
- Prevent an older background read from overwriting refreshed branch information
  after a push.
- Revalidate changed-line markers when Git attributes change, removing stale
  markers when the current attributes cannot be displayed safely and restoring
  them when supported again.

Source builds continue to use Zig 0.16.0. Linux x86_64 and macOS Apple Silicon
binaries are built and tested in ReleaseSafe mode.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/hiroaqii/gitframe/compare/v0.1.10...v0.1.11
